entrance.action: hook word 'DISASTER BILL' mask-reveal from below, bill object enters from above with a spring

mainActions.action: bill sheet opens, cost items print in sequence with tick SFX
red total count-up, 'UP 3x' stamp slam + shake

continueAction.action: bill folds into a question card, handoff to scene 2

exit.action: card grows to fill the screen (morph to scene 2)

entrance.action: card opens into a chart panel; first bar draws itself

mainActions.action: three chart bars fill in sequence with ease-in-out + ticks
'2026' number count-up above the last bar + bell

continueAction.action: last bar curves into a trend line to scene 3

exit.action: camera pans right following the trend line (camera-move)

entrance.action: trend line forms a tap; first water drop falls (plink)

mainActions.action: drops fall repeatedly, faster and faster, jar visibly fills
label 'Rp48,000/month' appears word by word with overshoot

continueAction.action: jar shifts left, empty space on the right for scene 4

exit.action: layout slide: jar stays on screen (handoff), new panel enters

entrance.action: comparison panel slides in from the right, two columns appear staggered

mainActions.action: 'without feature' column shrinks (reverse spring), 'with feature' column grows 0.1 s later at the same point
price difference count-up in green + sparkle

continueAction.action: both columns merge into one CTA card

exit.action: CTA card enlarges to the center (iris)

entrance.action: CTA card settles in the center; small logo fade-in below

mainActions.action: CTA 'Check your savings now' word by word + subtle button pulse
URL appears with sparkle; logo breathing

continueAction.action: all elements hold steady to be read

transition_plan.reason: the same object changes form; object continuity
the line continues the data story into the next scene

transition_plan.direction: shift left, panel enters from the right
transition_plan.reason: object kept as continuity, layout stays connected
focus moves to one closing call to action

ev.note: hook word must be fully readable at frame 0
